title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
statement: Return the node values level by level, left to right, as a list of lists. An empty tree gives an empty list.
reference_solution:
def levelOrder(root):
    out = []
    level = [root] if root else []
    while level:
        out.append([n.val for n in level])
        level = [c for n in level for c in (n.left, n.right) if c]
    return out

hints.1_question: How can you keep each level's nodes separate while walking the tree breadth-first?
hints.2_nudge: Process the tree one whole level at a time: take the current list of nodes, record their values, then build the next level from their children.
hints.3_big_hint: level = [root]; while level: out.append([n.val for n in level]); level = children of all nodes in level.
